title: AMP-BMS/MM: A Multiscale Neural Network Potential for the Fast and Accurate Simulation of Protein Dynamics and Enzymatic Reactions
authors: Moritz Thürlemann; Felix Pultar; Igor Gordiy; Enrico Ruijsenaars; Sereina Riniker
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了多尺度神经网络势AMP-BMS/MM用于蛋白质动力学和酶促反应的DFT精度模拟，虽非无序蛋白/PPI对象，但其AI+物理模拟方法对生物大分子互作机制建模具有可迁移启发。
abstract: We present the next generation of AMP, a neural network potential (NNP) with anisotropic message passing designed to study large biomolecular systems at DFT accuracy in the condensed phase using a multiscale approach similar to quantum-mechanics/molecular-mechanics (QM/MM) with electrostatic embedding. We trained AMPv3 on our recently published biomolecular multiscale simulation (BMS25) dataset and demonstrated the model’s high eﬃciency, which enabled us to simulate proteins involving thousands of atoms at DFT accuracy in addition to explicit MM solvent for up to hundred nanoseconds, which presents a major leap for contemporary NNPs. We observe excellent scaling to large systems on a single GPU. AMPv3-BMS25 (or short AMP-BMS) shows promising performance on benchmarks and we demonstrate that the model can be used to accurately estimate experimental properties, including solvation free energies of small molecules and structural features of proteins. Finally, AMP-BMS/MM was employed to predict the free-energy profiles of reactions catalyzed by the enzymes chorismate mutase and fluoroacetate dehalogenase. In total, AMP-BMS/MM was used to simulate proteins in the condensed phase for a cumulative 23 µs simulation time or 48 billion integration steps. This work establishes AMP-BMS as a highly eﬃcient and accurate model for multiscale simulations of biomolecules.
abstract_zh: 我们推出了下一代AMP，这是一种具有各向异性消息传递的神经网络势（NNP），旨在通过类似于量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）与静电嵌入的多尺度方法，在凝聚相中以DFT精度研究大型生物分子系统。我们在最近发布的生物分子多尺度模拟（BMS25）数据集上训练了AMPv3，并展示了该模型的高效率，这使我们能够在显式MM溶剂存在下，以DFT精度模拟包含数千个原子的蛋白质，时间尺度长达数百纳秒，这对当代NNP而言是一个重大飞跃。我们观察到在单个GPU上对大型系统具有出色的扩展性。AMPv3-BMS25（或简称AMP-BMS）在基准测试中表现出有前景的性能，我们证明该模型可用于准确估计实验性质，包括小分子的溶剂化自由能和蛋白质的结构特征。最后，我们采用AMP-BMS/MM预测了由酶分支酸变位酶和氟乙酸脱卤酶催化的反应自由能谱。总计，AMP-BMS/MM被用于模拟凝聚相中的蛋白质，累计模拟时间达23微秒，即480亿个积分步。这项工作确立了AMP-BMS作为生物分子多尺度模拟中高效且准确的模型。
